author: MarioNawfal
text:
🚨🇸🇦 SAUDI just GOT HIT.

A strike landed on the fuel tanks next to King Khalid Airport, in Riyadh.

The city had air-raid warnings before dawn.

Civil Defense later sent an all-clear. Saudi has not named the attacker, but everyone is pointing at the Houthis.

The war left the south and arrived at the airport.

Source: BBC / Writer: Lucas
